payload.body:
0115's FOUR PAGE AGENTS ARE DONE: 13 pages, 27 defects reported. I drove every one myself in my own fixtures (scratchpad/drive0115), each against a control. 26 reproduce. 1 I am not filing: fullcycle's preview re-points LATEST_CLEANRS, but LATEST_ follows the newest run by design and that seal says it was a dry run. 1 needs a ruling, at the end. NONE IS LIVE IN THE FLEET TODAY: from the 16 estates' configs and handlers, every rust estate's build handler answers --help without building, and the two Elixir estates with no db handler (arca_cli, Riffle) have no Ecto.

THE WORST THREE, all latent. (1) `db all` runs setup, migrate, reset (mix ecto.reset drops the database) and seed, then reports 'all db options passed'; a typo's refusal says '(try: bin/devbin db all)'. (2) fullcycle with a lone `commands.build.run: cargo build --release` removes target/, then `build all` refuses ('has no options to run'), and its remedy line names `build all`. (3) `fullcycle --dry-run` runs the project's build: its rebuild probe runs `build --help`, which a run: line passes to the script, while it prints 'DRY RUN -- nothing below is executed'.

ONE IS MINE. check.md:50 and test.md:47, written in 0113, say '`log: false` runs a shipped option unsealed'. run_option reads log: only inside its run: branch, so without a run: the key validates and does nothing (driven: db migrate with only log: false still sealed DBMIGRATE).

PROPOSED FILING, all for 0.1.8 under directive 13. All cc's by default. You may want B and F, which sit apart from the page work.
A clean (medium): cargo's CACHEDIR.TAG test takes pytest's cache, which --force removed; the elixir and swift arms run cargo's marker search, list cargo trees as ignored and print cargo's release/ note; --dry-run writes .metadata_never_index; the per-node test fires on _build/dev, .build/<triple>, target/<triple> and target/criterion; 'director(y|ies)' prints literally; the catalogue's 'deps/ is left alone' overclaims.
B db (high): `db all` includes reset; the refusal suggests `db all`; the MIX_ENV=prod guard lives in lib/cmd/db, so an option-level run: (the override D18 expects) runs under prod (driven: setup.run: mix ash.setup ran, rc 0).
C log: without run: (medium): validated, then ignored at option level, and at command level wherever devbin's handler runs; my two page sentences.
D fullcycle (high): (2) and (3) above; a working build whose tool rejects --help is refused as 'no build command'; the artefact check says 'The clean removed release/' when the clean removed nothing; the PATH watch compares link text with PROJECT_ROOT, so relative and /tmp-spelled links go unwatched and are left dangling unreported (clean itself saw all three); ask_person takes y/Y where devbin_offer_upgrade also takes yes/YES.
E dormancy (medium): a suite wholly behind features reads INCONCLUSIVE, not N dormant (the declared zero is promoted to failed); --all-features lands after a -- in a declared line; the printed declared line names a command that a test handler or a disabled option never runs; run: "" counts as undeclared (0082's rule).
F wrong reason or remedy (low): an enabled opt-in whose options are all disabled is refused as 'has not enabled it', and test with its only option disabled is told to declare project.languages; doctor says a filled name-only command 'shadows the built-in'; a non-executable handler is refused as not enabled, or told to add the file it already has; options.iex declared without a summary blanks --iex's line in help.
0128 AMENDED (low to medium): bin/devbin's `all` branch asks has_project_handler, so with commands.clean.run, `clean rust` runs the project's line while `clean all` runs devbin's arms (driven). And --iex is offered, then ignored, where commands.server.run owns server. Both are D2's tiers at a site 0128 does not list, and the first disagrees today.

RULING NEEDED: `all` as the first argument is refused with exit 1 on every option-less command. server, iex, cli and repl all say 'has no options to run', so cli and repl can never pass `all` to the project's program. bin/devbin:641-654 reserves it by design, and version.md documents the same for version. Keep it, or let an option-less command take `all` as an ordinary argument? D's fix depends on the answer, because `build all` over a lone build.run is where fullcycle fails.

PAGES: clean is audited; I am auditing the other 12 now. Each fix above that changes what a page says will edit that page in its own change. Say if you want a different grouping before I file; otherwise I file A-F and the 0128 amendment once the page audit is done.
